caseName: National Indian Youth Council v. Bruce
caseNameFull: National Indian Youth Council v. Bruce

opinions.text: C. A. 10th Cir. Motion of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied without prejudice to named individuals to file appropriate affidavits in forma pauperis. See 28 U. S. C. § 1915; Rule 53 of the Rules of this Court; and Pothier v. Rodman, 261 U. S. 307, 309 (1923).
